newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy GDP revision hit Q2 yr/yr figure - Istat.
newsitem.headline: Italy GDP revision hit Q2 yr/yr figure - Istat.

text.p: National statistics office Istat said on Friday a revision of Italy's gross domestic product (GDP) data for the second quarter of 1995 caused a lower-than- expected year-on-year figure for second quarter 1996 GDP.
"The 1995 Q2 figures have been revised up, consequently lowering the Q2 1996 year-on-year figure," Istat economist Laura Picozzi said, adding that Istat was constantly having to revise its GDP data.
She declined to say what the new 1995 figure was. Full GDP data is due on October 4.
Italy's GDP rose by a provisional 0.5 percent, year-on-year, in the second quarter of 1996 compared with many analysts forecasts of around 1.0 percent.
Previous Istat data for the second quarter of 1995 showed the economy growing 2.7 percent year-on-year.
On a quarter-by-quarter basis, Italy's GDP fell 0.5 percent between April and June this year.
